blocks.text: 今年 9 月，我们推出了 Projects，让工程师可以通过一个协调者指挥一群智能体，承接大规模的工作。今天，Projects 迎来一次重大升级：它现在支持多人协作了。把队友邀请进同一个 Project，你们就能和所有智能体一起规划、构建和交付。此前的多智能体系统都只服务一个人，而 Projects 是为整个团队打造的多智能体系统。

blocks.text: 团队协作软件并不少见，但讽刺的是，面向编程智能体的却一个也没有。Projects 是第一个让软件团队和他们的所有智能体并肩工作的空间，上下文、记忆和文档全部共享。共享任务板会显示谁在做什么、每个人的智能体在忙什么，以及每个任务对应的 PR，让人类和智能体都能看到统一且实时更新的全局视图。

blocks.text: 面向整个团队的统一上下文系统

inlines.text: 面向整个团队的统一上下文系统

blocks.text: 如今，智能体的上下文按人各自隔离，新成员必须先搭建并维护好自己的上下文，才能让智能体开始干活。在 Project 里，每位队友依然拥有与自己协调者和执行智能体的一对一对话，各自保有本地上下文。在此基础上，Projects 还增加了一套共享上下文系统，用来存放需求文档、示意图、技术规格、设计稿等资料。这个共享层只需搭建一次，之后随团队工作不断生长。在一个对话里做出的决定，Project 中的每个智能体都能获取。新队友被邀请进 Project 时，上下文已经预先配置好并且是最新的，省去了重复搭建的麻烦。

blocks.text: 这一点在值班场景中体现得最清楚。我们有好几个团队现在都在共享 Project 里轮值 on-call。最近有位工程师从队友手里接过轮值，他的协调者先做了确认，然后直接从当前进度接着干：它已经知道哪些工作在推进、哪些问题还没人处理、哪些事故和笔记需要交接，以及要盯住哪些频道、Linear 看板和讨论串。进行中的工作甚至可以直接交接：接手人的智能体直接把它接过来继续做。

blocks.text: 共享工作空间加上共享上下文，让队友之间的智能体也能互相沟通。这样一来，队友的智能体可以像人一样实时协调规划、互相解除阻塞。

inlines.text: 共享工作空间加上共享上下文，让队友之间的智能体也能互相沟通。这样一来，队友的智能体可以像人一样实时协调规划、互相解除阻塞。

blocks.text: 举个例子：一位工程师正在给产品页加评论功能，而一位设计师正在重新设计这个页面，双方的协调者会早早发现重叠并同步，让评论功能直接建进新设计里，避免日后返工重构。又或者，你的功能要读取某个数据库，而队友正在改它的表结构，双方的智能体会事先商定工作顺序，这样最后谁都不会撞上合并冲突。

inlines.text: 开始使用

blocks.text: 多人 Projects 首次把协作软件的精神带给了 AI 智能体，让人类团队和智能体集群拥有同一个共享空间协同工作。从今天起，Cursor 的所有用户都可以通过 beta 版体验。要开始使用，从左侧导航栏创建一个 Project，然后邀请队友加入即可。

blocks.text: In September we introduced Projects, a way for engineers to take on large-scale work by directing a fleet of agents through a single coordinator. Today Projects gets a major upgrade: it's now multiplayer. Invite your teammates into a Project, and you can plan, build and ship together, alongside all of your agents. Multi-agent systems have so far served one person. Projects is a multi-agent system built for a whole team.

blocks.text: There's no shortage of software for team collaboration, but ironically, none for coding agents. Projects is the first workspace where software teams work side by side with all of their agents, with shared context, memory, and documents. A shared task board shows who's doing what, what everyone's agents are working on, and the PR behind each task, giving humans and agents alike a unified, up-to-date view.

blocks.text: A unified context system for a whole team

inlines.text: A unified context system for a whole team

blocks.text: Today, agent context is siloed per person, and new team members have to build and maintain context before putting agents to work. In a Project, each teammate still gets their own one-to-one chat with their coordinator and worker agents, each with its own local context. On top of that, Projects adds a shared context system that holds requirements docs, diagrams, tech specs, mockups, and more. The shared layer is built once and grows with the team's work. A decision made in one chat is accessible to every agent in the Project. When a new teammate is invited to a Project, context is pre-configured and up to date, avoiding repetitive setup.

blocks.text: We've seen this most clearly in on-call. Several of our teams now run their on-call rotations in a shared Project. When one of our engineers recently took over the rotation from a teammate, their coordinator picked up right where things stood, after checking in first. It already knew what work was in flight, which issues were still unattended, which incidents and notes needed handing off, and which channels, Linear boards and threads to keep an eye on. In-progress work can even be handed over directly: the new person's agent simply takes it on.

blocks.text: Agent-to-agent communication across teammates

inlines.text: Agent-to-agent communication across teammates

blocks.text: A shared workspace and shared context open up agent-to-agent communication between teammates. This lets teammates' agents plan around and unblock each other in real time, just as people do.

inlines.text: A shared workspace and shared context open up agent-to-agent communication between teammates. This lets teammates' agents plan around and unblock each other in real time, just as people do.

blocks.text: For example, if an engineer is adding reviews to the product page while a designer is redesigning it, their coordinators spot the overlap early and sync up, so the reviews are built straight into the new design, with no refactors down the road. Or if your feature reads from a database while your teammate is changing the schema, your agents agree on the order of work up front, so neither of you hits a merge conflict at the end.

blocks.text: Get Started

inlines.text: Get Started

blocks.text: Multiplayer Projects brings the spirit of collaboration software to AI agents for the first time, giving human teams and agent fleets one shared space to work together. It's rolling out in beta to all users in Cursor starting today. To get started, create a Project from the left-hand nav, then invite your teammates to join.
